value: FINDING 1 — BUILD_INSPECTOR CANNOT SEE skills/ AT ALL. Criterion 2's named instrument was `python3 -m cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector` on the sail address; it REFUSES, loudly and correctly: 'no component skills/sail under <root>/cairn — the census sees [base, build_inspector, bus, chart, charter, db_domain, diagnostic_inspector, ground_loop, harbor_master, inference_domain, intention_extractor, intentions_model_compiler, librarian, orient, sudo_relay, system_rackmount, tester, trouble, web_server]. A gate that silently inspects nothing passes everything (Law 8).' orient's device_census is scoped to cairn/, so EVERY filter regime — charter_on_disk, proofs_exist, silent_device, state_is_projection — has zero jurisdiction over skills/, the very class this stone just taught to cross. The instrument was not substituted away: the invariant it measures (state == project(history)) was verified directly through cairn.tools.charter.projector and holds. But the criterion as charted was not runnable, and that is recorded rather than smoothed. CONSEQUENCE FOR ticket nothing-rides-loose, cast the same day: its crossing-half filter would not cover skills/ either — the census scope is a prerequisite that ticket does not yet name. Carry it there.

FINDING 2 — THE 'SAME ACT' RECOMPILE POKE WAS NOT SATISFIED for the sail charter delta. H3 expected 'both charter deltas landed with the recompile poked in the same act'; in fact both charter edits landed at ~12:32 (builder) and the model write-door was poked ~3h later at close. The INVARIANT never lapsed — the gate is on-read, and /intent pokes before consulting, so any reader in that window refreshed first — but the procedural expectation as written was missed. Recorded as the honest partial it is, not passed silently. The distinction worth keeping: 'same act' is stricter than the invariant it protects (model current AT READ), which is the [[proof-over-live-data-assert-invariants]] shape — pin the invariant, not the procedure.
